rules.rule_context:
Appeal review scope note from RelayHost Legal/Policy Operations:

An appeal receives individual review when the reviewer opens the specific case record and confirms that the stated grounds for appeal have been examined against the original enforcement decision and the current platform policy in force at the time of review. A statement of reasons accompanies the closure when the closure notice to the user contains text specific to that appeal, drawn from the reviewer's direct input or from a template selected and confirmed as applicable to that individual case after the reviewer has reviewed it.

Batch closure without per-case confirmation, or generation of closure notices with only a generic outcome label and no case-specific reason text, falls outside this scope. Pre-filled reason fields that the reviewer confirms without opening the case record also fall outside this scope.

The test is whether a reviewer with no prior knowledge of the case could reconstruct, from the closure notice alone, which policy provision was applied to which stated ground and why that ground was accepted or rejected. If the notice does not permit that reconstruction, the appeal has not received individual review and a statement of reasons within the meaning of the policy.
